# join

Join two sorted files on a common field through MoonX.

## Usage

```sh
moonx cli/join first.txt second.txt

moonx cli/join -t : -1 1 -2 1 first.txt second.txt
```

Join on the first whitespace-delimited field by default. Select fields, output columns and unpaired records as needed.

## Common options

<!-- BEGIN GENERATED OPTIONS -->

| Option | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `-1 VALUE`, `--field1 VALUE` | Choose each file's join field. |
| `-2 VALUE`, `--field2 VALUE` | Choose each file's join field. |
| `-t VALUE`, `--separator VALUE` | Set a single-byte field separator. |
| `-a VALUE`, `--after VALUE` | Include unpaired rows from file 1 or 2. |
| `-e VALUE`, `--empty VALUE` | Replace missing or empty fields. Default: `""`. |
| `-o VALUE`, `--output VALUE` | Choose output fields. |
| `-i`, `--ignore-case` | Compare keys ignoring ASCII case. |
| `-h`, `--help` | Show help. |
| `--version` | Show the version. |
<!-- END GENERATED OPTIONS -->

Use `--help` for the complete option list.

## Notes

Workspace builds use the MoonBit 2026-11-26 toolchain.

- Inputs must be sorted by the selected join fields. Comparison uses C-locale bytes and optional ASCII case folding.

See the [compatibility guide](../../docs/compatibility.md) for the supported profile.
